   - Updated `getCustomer(id)` to normalize the ID before looking it up in the customer list

   - Added 2 tests for `createInvoice()` to verify it stores the normalized customer ID

The system now gracefully handles customer IDs in any case with any amount of leading/trailing whitespace, normalizing them consistently for storage and lookup.
